name: kms
description: Vivantel KMS (Knowledge Management System): give your AI coding agent durable, checkable knowledge — decisions, facts, and guardrails it won't forget, contradict, or re-litigate. Everyday development skills for Claude Code. Get started fast with quickstart, brainstorm approaches to a problem, or rigorously clarify a plan through interrogation and turn one into durable knowledge artifacts and a standalone roadmap; bootstrap a project's fact/decision/guardrail system, capture each session's decisions into it, lint it for structural rot, query it for answers with citations, onboard a role from it, or plan a refactor against it; check a pending change conforms before it lands, attribute commits and PRs to their underlying intent, generate changelogs from commit history, and uninstall cleanly when you're done.
